shortDescription: Manage Cloud Foundry Service Instance Keys

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint URL of the Cloud Foundry API.

options.name: key_name
options.description: The name of the service instance key to manage.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for authentication with the Cloud Foundry API.

options.name: service_instance_guid
options.description: The GUID of the service instance for which to manage keys.

options.name: service_instance_name
options.description: The name of the service instance for which to manage keys.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the service instance key.

options.name: username
options.description: The username for authentication with the Cloud Foundry API. This is SAP BTP user email address
